summary: Frontend-only verification of the new SIZE autocomplete field on the tool details form. All three requested UX flows PASS end-to-end on mobile web preview (390x844) using Pro account mechanicltz@gmail.com: (1) SIZE field with testID 'edit-size' renders directly below BRAND ('edit-brand') in the edit form (DOM order confirmed: edit-brand at index 125,814 and edit-size at index 127,349 in the rendered HTML; visual screenshots confirm placement immediately after BRAND). (2) Autocomplete works: typing '10' in the empty SIZE field shows the 'size-suggest-10mm' dropdown row; tapping it fills the input with '10mm', save persists, and the item detail view now shows a SIZE row (below BRAND, using testID 'details-row-size') with value '10mm'. (3) Auto-grow verified: entered a brand-new size string '42XX' on Test item (03784723), saved successfully; GET /api/sizes now includes '42XX' with a fresh id; then opened a DIFFERENT item (New Item, a6a81691) in edit mode, typed '42' in its SIZE field, and 'size-suggest-42XX' appears as an autocomplete suggestion — confirming the list grows from the user's own input, exactly like BRAND. Backend smoke also confirmed: /api/sizes returns list and PUT /api/tools upserts new sizes. No regressions observed.

critical_code_review_comments: SizeAutocomplete.tsx is a faithful mirror of BrandAutocomplete.tsx (same fetch-on-mount, filter/dedupe/cap-at-6, focus/blur delay, close-icon reset). Component looks clean, uses testID prop, wraps text in <Text>, and follows StyleSheet.create — no RN issues detected.

renderDetailsEdit places SIZE immediately after BRAND (tool/[id].tsx lines 2300-2304). renderDetailsView also renders SIZE right after BRAND (lines 2228-2229) using vRow('SIZE','resize', ...). Symmetry maintained between view and edit modes.
seed_data_creation: Added user-generated size '42XX' to /api/sizes via saving it on Test item (03784723). Test item now has size='42XX'. If this bleeds into other tests, main agent may want to reset that tool's size — but per the spec this is the intended growth behavior and no cleanup needed.
